input: Find overnight, sleepaway and residential summer camps and summer programs for kids and teens in or near Waynesville, Canton, Clyde, Maggie Valley and Lake Junaluska, NC (Haywood County). Search the web thoroughly (several searches with different wording and town names) and list every organization you find.
searches: Haywood county overnight summer camp 2026 Waynesville

candidates.name: Skyland Camp and Retreats
candidates.note: Overnight girls’ camp for rising grades 1–10 and mother-daughter sessions; summer 2027 dates announced.

candidates.name: Daniel Boone Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Camp Daniel Boone offers residential Scout camp, high-adventure trips and living-history programs; 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Lake Logan Episcopal Center
candidates.note: Camp Henry offers 3–7-day youth sessions, family camp and Outdoor School wilderness trips; 2026 family handbook published.

candidates.name: M28 Ministries
candidates.note: Four-day, three-night summer camps for middle and high school youth groups, with worship, discipleship and recreation; ran in 2026.

candidates.name: SOAR
candidates.note: Residential outdoor-adventure camps for youth with ADHD and learning differences; North Carolina sessions include introductory cabin stays and backpacking.
